Manage Login Access

UsernamePasswordRoleLinked MemberStatusActions

To reset someone's password: type their username and a new password above, then click "Add / Update User" — it will overwrite their old password.

Import Members from Treasurer's Register

This loads 170 members from the EKFS Treasurer's Report (Sex, Member No., Name, CIG, ID, Contact, Registration Fee, Share Capital) directly into the Member Register. Existing members with a matching Member Number will be skipped, so it's safe to click more than once.

Import Zone Mobilizers

Loads the 16 zone representatives (Kachieng' North, Kachieng' South, Sino Upper, Sino Lower) into the Mobilizer Register. Anyone already registered (same ID number) is skipped.

Farmer Directory

Load the NAVCDP Member Directory file (the .html you received) into the system. It is stored in the database and shown only after sign-in to Officials and Mobilizers. Step 2 fills Age Bracket, Value Chain and Directory Group on registered members whose name matches exactly one directory farmer.

CIG Names Cleanup

Finds CIG / group names written in more than one way (for example "Jikaze" and "Jikaze Group"), highlights them, and lets you amend or clear them everywhere.
